stateDiagram-v2
[*] --> Grouped: Core records normalized failure fingerprint
Grouped --> Grouped: Append occurrence diagnosis or workaround
Grouped --> Investigating: User starts bounded investigation
Investigating --> CandidatePrepared: Core registers complete candidate evidence and rollback point
CandidatePrepared --> AwaitingActivation: Disclosure hash and Management checkpoint committed
AwaitingActivation --> Rejected: User rejects candidate
AwaitingActivation --> ActivatedRestarting: User explicitly selects Activate and restart
ActivatedRestarting --> Verifying: Candidate hash starts and same Management task resumes
ActivatedRestarting --> RolledBack: Startup watchdog fails
Verifying --> Verified: Focused verification succeeds
Verifying --> RolledBack: Verification fails or candidate identity mismatches
Verified --> RegressionReopened: Matching failure occurs again
RolledBack --> RegressionReopened: Matching failure recurs
RegressionReopened --> Investigating: User starts a new bounded investigation
Rejected --> Investigating: User requests revised investigation
Verified --> [*]: Outcome remains inspectable
RolledBack --> [*]: Rollback evidence and previous working pointer remain
Rejected --> [*]: Rejection remains inspectable

data.title: Recurring Error and Repair Candidate Evidence Lifecycle
